items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: Although, much of my colleagues used to play. Piku and all of them used to play.

ctx.x: Some of them had been students of Xavier. I thought I mean Xavier. That was given out to Xavier or Dillard? Xavier. Xavier. Yeah, that's what I meant. That was given out Xavier. That was December 32.

Yeah. And of course, like those fellows would be the... Now as far as jazz is concerned, I used to play a lot of jazz on the piano, you know? Oh yes. But I never did fancy very much of piling up in those... the red light districts. I never said to go around there. I didn't want to worry about that at all. Although, much of my colleagues used to play. Piku and all of them used to play.
Professor Minetta's told us about those. He played at the tuxedo dance hall and some of the houses and all too. Yes. Yes. He's told us all about that. But I used to play for private people.
